inventar.name: Inventory
inventar.server.gesperrt: This server does not allow automatic inventory clicks – sorting is off.
inventar.cursor_voll: No free slot for the item on your cursor – not sorted.
inventar.seite.sortieren.info: Sort order, key and quick move
inventar.seite.warnung.info: Warning and sound when a tool is about to break
inventar.o.sortieren.info: The sort key orders the open inventory or container. The hotbar stays as it is.
inventar.o.art.info: Order of the items; equal items are first combined into full stacks.
inventar.art.name: Name
inventar.o.ziehen.info: Hold Shift + left mouse button and drag over slots: every item moves instantly between inventory and container.
inventar.seite.sperre.info: Lock hotbar slots against dropping, deleting and moving
inventar.o.gesperrt.info: Items in these slots cannot be dropped, deleted or moved – not even in the creative inventory. They still drop on death.
inventar.o.warnung.info: Shows a warning above the hotbar when the tool in your hand is about to break.
inventar.o.schwelle.info: Remaining durability at which the warning starts.
inventar.o.ton.info: Plays a sound once when a tool drops below the threshold.
